name: REST API
description: Connect to any REST API endpoint with support for offset, cursor, and link-header pagination, incremental sync, and API key, bearer token, or basic auth.
author: OnePlatform

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the REST API (e.g. https://api.example.com/v1)

endpoint.description: Path to the resource endpoint, relative to baseUrl (e.g. /orders)

method.description: HTTP method to use when fetching records

headers.description: Static request headers to include with every fetch (e.g. Accept, X-API-Version)

responseDataPath.description: Dot-delimited JSON path to the array of records in the response body (e.g. 'data', 'results.items'). Omit to treat the root as the array.

paginationType.description: Pagination strategy: none (single request), offset (?offset=N&limit=N), cursor (?cursor=TOKEN&limit=N), link (follow Link header rel=next)

pageSize.description: Number of records per page for offset and cursor pagination

incrementalField.description: Field name used for incremental sync filtering (e.g. 'updated_at'). When set, appends ?{incrementalField}={cursor} to requests after the first.

requiredCredentials.name: apiKey
requiredCredentials.description: API key sent as the X-API-Key header

requiredCredentials.name: bearerToken
requiredCredentials.description: Bearer token sent as the Authorization: Bearer header
